The object resembles a bandage but lacks functional components and correct proportions, resulting in a low alignment score despite the classifier's confidence.

The hand holding the object exhibits structural collapse/fusion, where fingers merge into the bandage edge. While the texture of the bandage itself is plausible (perforated beige fabric), the integration with the human subject and the textual elements are fundamentally flawed. These structural and textual artifacts significantly degrade the image quality.
